name: Golnir Bouldertoe
summary: Beside Ironforge's Great Forge, Golnir Bouldertoe supplies miners and prospectors and receives dispatches for couriers and travelers.

sections.title: Merchant of the Great Forge
sections.body: At Ironforge's Great Forge, Golnir Bouldertoe outfits prospectors and craftsmen with the necessities of their trade. He sells sturdy mining picks, flux, and coal, supplies that fuel the smelting fires and smithies that define the dwarven capital. Kin to Geofram Bouldertoe, Golnir is a reliable contact for workers arriving in the city. He directs fresh hands and receives supply messages carried from nearby outposts.

faq.q: Where can I find Golnir Bouldertoe?
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe works in Ironforge's Great Forge, near the central smelting and blacksmithing areas alongside fellow trade merchants.
Golnir sells mining picks, coal, and flux to prospectors digging and refining raw ore.

faq.q: Is Golnir Bouldertoe involved in any quests?
faq.answer: Yes. Courier errands connect the surrounding dwarven settlements to the capital. Travelers carrying messages from outposts such as Thelsamar, including those linked to Gryth Thurden and incoming flights, deliver them directly into Golnir's hands.

faq.q: Is Golnir related to anyone else in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Golnir shares his clan name with Geofram Bouldertoe, the mining trainer who works beside him in Ironforge's Great Forge.

angles.text: Miners visiting the Great Forge rely on Golnir for vital tools of the craft, including spare picks and flux needed to smelt raw vein-work into refined bars.
For dwarves returning from their first journeys out in Coldridge or Kharanos, Golnir is an early contact in the capital, welcoming travelers beside the mountain's fiery heart.
